highlights: UGREEN 75497 FineTrack Slim G (Android Only) Wallet Tracker Card, 5-Year Battery Bluetooth Tracker Card Work with Find Hub App, IP68 Waterproof Smart Google Tracker Card for Wallet Luggage[Google Certified]

Easy Find & Family Sharing with Google Find Hub App: Effortlessly pair the FineTrack Slim G wallet tracker card with your Android phone in just one press. Using the Google Find Hub app (download required), you can easily add the tracker card to your account to locate and keep track of your wallet, luggage, and other valuables. Besides Trackering item, you can also share your tracker's location with family members, so everyone can help keep your belongings safe. (Note: Compatible with Android 9.0 and above only, Not for iOS)

Smart Tracking Made Easy: Whether Bluetooth Tracker card is nearby or far away, locate it easily with the Find Hub app for Android. When within Bluetooth range, play a sound to quickly find the wallet tracker card; when out of range, the Google Find Hub app will use the vast ecosystem of Android devices to provide the wallet finder card’s latest location. Enjoy global tracking with Google Find Hub app without any subscription fees.

Lost Item Alerts & Lost Mode: When your Android wallet tracker card moves out of range, the Google Find Hub app sends an lost alert with the last known location. If your item is confirmed lost, you can leave your contact information in Lost Mode and so nearby Android devices can remotely access it and help locate your tracker card, making recovery quick and easy. (The above functions need to activate Lost Mode before use)

5-Year Battery Life – Enjoy up to 60 months of uninterrupted protection. With an extended battery life, there's no need for frequent replacements. You can check the current battery level anytime through the app and replace the battery when needed.

Ultra-Thin 1.7mm & IP68 Waterproof: Made with advanced cold-press technology, this slim tracker is as thin as a credit card, yet incredibly durable. It easily slips into wallets, passports, and cardholders, combining both style and resilience. Whether caught in the rain or exposed to dust, the IP68 rating ensures your items are always protected—ideal for travel, hiking, and outdoor adventures.
